To date [1 JULY 2025],

67 satellites have been launched by 18 African countries.

11 of those 67 satellites were launched by commercial entities.

The first satellite was launched in 1998 by Egypt - Nilesat-101.

Botswana is the latest African country to launch a satellite. They launched BotSat-1 on 15 March 2025.
